subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned `requireMention` group messages for later mentioned turns, and what bounds must that retention use?
rationale: The source fix shape is clear, but preserving bystander group media changes the privacy and retention boundary for Telegram groups and cannot be safely chosen by automation.

options.title: Approve bounded Telegram history media
options.body: Use shared `HistoryEntry.media` with strict image-only/local-path, TTL/count, visibility, and live Telegram proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Keep text-only skipped history
options.body: Leave the current privacy-preserving behavior in place and close this issue as not planned if unmentioned media retention is unacceptable.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in first
options.body: Add or use an explicit group-level policy before retaining unmentioned media, accepting extra product/config review before any code fix.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Telegram history media
recommendation.body: Use shared `HistoryEntry.media` with strict image-only/local-path, TTL/count, visibility, and live Telegram proof requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged shared history-media path and cross-channel policy surface came through steipete's recent work, making him the best available owner for the security/product choice.
